goal_ru: После урока ты сможешь рассказать, что есть в твоём городе и районе.
can_do_en: I can say what there is in my town and my neighbourhood.

words.example_en: There's a big park near my house.
We go to the shopping centre at the weekend.
words.example_ru: На выходных ходим в торговый центр.

words.example_en: The bus stop is next to the shop.
There are a lot of lakes near Chelyabinsk.
There are big factories in my city.
There are a lot of cafés.

grammar.title_ru: There is / are о городе + a lot of / some / any; описание: big, quiet, busy
grammar.explain_ru: Повторяем There is / There are, но в городе: There's a park. There are a lot of shops (много магазинов). There are some cafés (несколько). В вопросе и отрицании — any: Are there any museums? There aren't any clubs. Описание города — прилагательные: My city is big and busy. My street is quiet.
grammar.explain_en: There's a cinema. There are a lot of shops. There aren't any beaches. Is there a gym near here? My city is big and busy.

examples.en: There are a lot of lakes near Chelyabinsk.
Are there any good parks in your city?
examples.ru: Есть ли в твоём городе хорошие парки?

examples.en: My neighbourhood is quiet, but the centre is busy.
examples.ru: Мой район тихий, а центр шумный.

mistakes.wrong: There are many shops (в утверждении — звучит книжно)
mistakes.right: There are a lot of shops.
mistakes.why_ru: В разговоре в утверждениях — a lot of.

mistakes.wrong: In my city there is a lot of parks.
mistakes.right: There are a lot of parks in my city.

grammar.tutor_notes_ru: Брать реальный город ученика (Челябинск: озёра, заводы, Кировка, парк Гагарина). Не требовать точных фактов — важен язык. Ученик рассказывает Нейту, «который никогда не был на Урале».

phrases.en: It's a big / small / quiet / busy city.
phrases.ru: Это большой / маленький / тихий / шумный город.

questions_en: Is your city big or small?
What is there in your neighbourhood?
What's your favourite place in the city? Why?
talk.tutor_notes_ru: Нейт расспрашивает как турист: Is there a cinema? Are there any good cafés? Ученик рекламирует город.

tasks.question: Are there ___ museums in your town?

tasks.text: There ___ a lot of shops, but there ___ any cinemas. My street is very ___.

tasks.from_ru: Рядом с моим домом есть большой парк.
tasks.answer: There's a big park near my house.

tasks.ask_ru: Послушай рассказ без текста. Чего НЕТ в районе Эммы?
tasks.audio: I live in a small town. In my neighbourhood there's a park, a library and some cafés. There aren't any cinemas, so we go to the next town to watch films.
tasks.question: Чего нет в её районе?

tasks.text: Я живу в Челябинске. Это большой город, и рядом много озёр.
answers: I live in Chelyabinsk. It's a big city and there are a lot of lakes near it.
I live in Chelyabinsk. It is a big city, and there are a lot of lakes nearby.

tasks.ask_ru: Это карта района. Расскажи, что в нём есть и чего нет.

image.prompt_en: Simple colourful cartoon map of a neighbourhood: a park with trees, a library, a gym, two cafés, a bus stop and a small lake, no cinema, top-down flat style, icons only, no labels
image.alt_ru: Карта района: парк, библиотека, спортзал, два кафе, остановка, маленькое озеро; кинотеатра нет.

tasks.say: What is there in this neighbourhood?
tasks.example: There's a park with a lot of trees. There's a library and a gym. There are two cafés. There's a small lake. There aren't any cinemas.

tasks.ask_ru: Нейт — турист и впервые в твоём городе. Он задаёт вопросы — ответь и посоветуй любимое место.
tasks.scenario_ru: Нейт приехал на Урал и расспрашивает о городе.
tasks.tutor_role: a tourist who has never been to the Urals
tasks.opening: So, I'm here for two days. Is there anything to do in this city?
goals_ru: ответить на Is there…? / Are there any…?
example: T: Is there anything to do in this city?
L: Yes! There are a lot of parks and lakes.
T: Are there any good cafés?
L: Yes, there are some cafés in the centre.
L: My favourite place is the Gagarin park. It's big and quiet.

tasks.say: There are a lot of lakes near my city.

homework.about_ru: Запиши голосом мини-рекламу своего района для иностранца: 5–6 фраз и любимое место.

tasks.say: Sell me your neighbourhood. Why should I visit?
tasks.example: My neighbourhood is quiet and green. There's a big park and a new gym. There are some cafés. There aren't any cinemas, but the centre is near. My favourite place is the lake.

pass.about_ru: Пройден, если верно 75% заданий и в роли гида (t8) ты ответил на вопросы туриста с There is/are.

review.note_ru: Откуда ты (A0) + There is/are и предлоги.
